ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_System_Automation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Candidate", TR1__TimesParsed__c > 0, OR( ISBLANK(MailingStreet), ISBLANK(MailingCity), ISBLANK(MailingCountry), ISBLANK(MailingPostalCode) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must add a Street, City, Country and Postcode to the Address.
